prompts.huskarl: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production animation sprite sheet for Crown & Kingdoms, medieval isometric RTS. Input image is character identity and painted style reference, not edit target. Create a 1536x1024 PNG with genuine transparent alpha. Strict FOUR columns and FOUR rows, sixteen cells of 384x256, exactly one complete figure per cell. Fixed elevated isometric camera about 30 degrees, facing screen RIGHT with slight front view. Consistent proportions, character size, feet baseline, upper-left lighting. Crisp detailed hand-painted medieval miniatures, earthy materials, dark readable outlines; cobalt BLUE cloth/heraldry for team recolouring, neutral skin, steel, leather, wood and gold. No background, floor, shadows, scenery, text, grid lines, labels, glow or detached fragments. Keep entire feet, weapon tips, shields and headgear inside each cell with at least 16 pixels transparent margin. Upper two rows frames 0-7: continuous eight-frame walking cycle, alternating left/right planted, passing and extended steps, natural articulated legs, arms and cloth. Lower two rows frames 8-15: ready guard, draw weapon back, raise/prepare weapon, final wind-up, full strike toward right, follow-through, recovery, return ready. Actual changing articulated poses, no whole-body rotation or wobble, no direction turntable. Equipment and anatomy remain identical across all frames, no duplicate limbs or floating weapons. Subject: Huskarl matching reference: sturdy bearded medieval infantryman, pointed steel nasal helmet, dark chainmail shirt/skirt over padded beige sleeves, brown leather bracers/belt/boots, dark trousers. Round cobalt BLUE wooden shield with brass rim/boss and radial braces strapped to LEFT forearm, one medium wood-handled single steel axe in RIGHT hand. Walk with shield forward and axe low. Attack a one-handed axe chop, shield always attached and braced. No horns, fur cloak or sword; retain the same single-headed axe in every pose.
